caption: The drawing displays two metallic objects shaped like birds, each adorned with a red, round cushion. The upper object consists of a horizontally oriented bird in a dark, metallic color with intricate feather engravings. This bird is perched on a vertical support that integrates a key-like element at the bottom, featuring a quatrefoil cutout, and a small rectangular protrusion to the left. A red, fabric-covered cushion is positioned on the bird's back and another, larger red cushion sits below the bird on the right side, resting on a curved support. The lower object is another bird, viewed from above, also rendered in dark metal with engraved wing details and a single round, red cushion attached to its center. Both objects are depicted on a plain, off-white background. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Sewing Bird
